name: Quarterly headcount plan keeper
why: Checks the headcount plan against last quarter's hires and exits, the same job as the quarterly headcount review.

name: Plan a year of hiring and what it will cost
why: A year of hiring with its cost, matching the headcount plan and cost skill.

name: Monthly contractor roster keeper
why: Checks contractor invoices against what was agreed and drafts missing agreements, as in the contractor roster steps.

name: Support capacity planner
why: Plans support staffing for a sales peak from ticket data, a queue case of staffing from demand.

name: Support hiring date planner
why: Works out agents needed each month and when to start hiring, the timing step in a seasonal plan.

name: Check production shift staffing commitments
why: Checks shift staffing against production commitments, the rota check for makers and warehouses.

name: Restaurant shift exception review assistant
why: Reviews restaurant shift exceptions, useful in the weekly review step of the rota cycle.

name: Weekly team coverage review assistant
why: Finds critical work left without cover during absences, alongside the weekly rota.

name: Plan staff coverage during a disruption
why: Coverage options when a disruption hits staff availability, beyond the normal rota.

name: Hiring pipeline runner
why: Scores applicants the same way against a guide for seasonal or planned hires; the client decides on every person.

name: New hire onboarding keeper
why: Plans and tracks a new hire's first weeks once the headcount plan turns into a start date.

name: Prepare a seasonal cash buffer
why: Builds the cash buffer a seasonal wage bill needs before the peak pays for itself.
